procurement_question: What AI/cloud workflow is being supplied and which users or patients are affected?
evidence_packet: Use-case summary; data-flow note; product owner narrative; redacted screenshots
submit_condition: Submit only when scope exclusions and human-review boundaries are named
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not imply unrestricted clinical automation or patient-outcome proof

procurement_question: Is a DPIA, DPA or privacy review required before deployment?
evidence_packet: DPIA screening status; adviser questions; retention/deletion notes; approved DPO comments
submit_condition: Submit when qualified owner has approved the wording or flagged adviser-needed rows
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim GDPR compliance, DPIA approval or lawful-basis certainty without approved evidence

procurement_question: Could the workflow be high-risk or require specific human oversight controls?
evidence_packet: Classification decision log; risk register row; human override path; change-control evidence
submit_condition: Submit when classification status is reviewed or clearly marked unresolved
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim EU AI Act compliance, safety approval or autonomous decisioning readiness

procurement_question: Which security controls, audits, certifications or trust-centre artifacts can be shared?
evidence_packet: Security questionnaire source map; policy index; audit/certification status; approved redactions
submit_condition: Submit when every certification/control answer has a source or is marked not available
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim ISO/SOC 2/NHS/certification status that has not been verified

procurement_question: Where is data hosted and which subprocessors or LLM providers are involved?
evidence_packet: Subprocessor register; region notes; data-processing boundary; training-use statement source
submit_condition: Submit when residency transfer and model-provider language is owner-approved
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not promise data residency, no-training use or cross-border transfer guarantees without evidence

procurement_question: How are AI, cloud and LLM costs controlled, approved and reported?
evidence_packet: Owner dashboard; budget gate; anomaly approval runbook; cost-claim worksheet
submit_condition: Submit when cost evidence is scoped to control process, not unverified savings
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim savings, ROI, runway extension or buyer cost reduction without measured evidence
